project: Knight Lore Reimagined — Modern 3D Filmation Engine
description: Comprehensive record of intellectual property, open-source code, fonts, audio, 3D assets, art, and tooling attributions.

attributions.name: Knight Lore (1984)
attributions.original_publisher: Ultimate Play the Game (Ashby Computers & Graphics Ltd)
attributions.license: Copyright © 1984 Ultimate Play the Game / Rights held by Microsoft (Rare Ltd). Used here non-commercially for educational tribute, historical preservation, and technological reimagining.
attributions.usage_in_project: Core game mechanics, 128-room map topology, 40-day celestial Sun/Moon cycle, Sabreman / Werewolf transformation, 14 cauldron charms, Melkhior the Wizard, and entity kinematic behaviours.

attributions.name: The Complete Knight Lore Disassembly & RAM Map
attributions.usage_in_project: Reference for coordinate systems (X, Y, Z discrete 0..255 space), room layout tables (location_tbl), graphic sprite indices (0..187), and authentic entity collision bounding boxes.

attributions.name: Godot Engine (v4.7.2 Standard)
attributions.copyright: Copyright (c) 2014-present Godot Engine contributors; Copyright (c) 2007-2014 Juan Linietsky, Ariel Manzur
attributions.usage_in_project: Core runtime game engine (Forward+ renderer, scene graph, GDScript 2.0 runtime, SubViewport compositor, and multi-platform export pipelines).

attributions.name: Godot Jolt (Jolt Physics 3D)
attributions.copyright: Copyright (c) 2023-present Jorrit Rouwe, Godot Jolt contributors
attributions.usage_in_project: Default 3D physics engine for Godot 4, driving CharacterBody3D and AnimatableBody3D kinematic simulation, half-grid pushable block snapping, and analytical jumping.

attributions.name: GUT (Godot Unit Test) v9.6.1
attributions.usage_in_project: Automated headless unit and physics testing framework (running 100+ tests and 4,000+ assertions across 16 test suites in CI/verification).

attributions.name: Metamorphous Regular
attributions.copyright: Copyright (c) 2011, Sorkin Type Co (www.sorkintype.com) with Reserved Font Name 'Metamorphous'
attributions.usage_in_project: Primary user interface typeface for embossed medieval parchment text across menus, HUD scrolls, dialogue prompts, and toast notifications (res://assets/ui/Metamorphous-Regular.ttf).

attributions.name: GeneralUser GS (v1.471)
attributions.license: Permissive (Free for musical creation, personal and commercial software projects)
attributions.usage_in_project: General MIDI orchestral soundfont sample library used by FluidSynth to render multi-track orchestral scores (Strings, French Horn, Oboe, Harp, Flute, Cello, Timpani, Celesta).

attributions.name: Knight Lore 1-Bit Beeper Tunes (Title, Fanfare, Shimmer, Epilogue)
attributions.license: Original compositions © 1984 Ultimate Play the Game
attributions.usage_in_project: Melodic and contrapuntal themes decoded from ZX Spectrum beeper frequency routines (data/knight_lore/audio.json) and adapted into full orchestral arrangements.

attributions.name: Knight Lore Reimagined Orchestral Soundtrack
attributions.usage_in_project: Full symphonic contrapuntal arrangements rendered offline via FluidSynth (score_menu.ogg, score_start_game.ogg, score_gameplay_day.ogg, score_gameplay_night.ogg, score_game_over.ogg, score_game_complete.ogg in assets/audio/music/).

attributions.name: Natural Biome Soundscapes & Acoustic Sound Effects
attributions.usage_in_project: Procedurally synthesized 30-second stereo ambience loops (woodland day/night, dungeon) and 24 acoustic foley effects (footsteps, landings, block scrapes, iron gates, magic sparkles) in assets/audio/ambience/ and assets/audio/sfx/.

attributions.name: Knight Lore 41 Normalized PBR 3D Assets
attributions.tooling: Blender 5.3.0 headless procedural sculpt & normalization pipeline
attributions.usage_in_project: 41 PBR .glb assets spanning 17-bone rigged characters (Sabreman Explorer, Werewolf, Melkhior Wizard, Sentinel), architecture (masonry panels, arches, lintels), interactive props, and 7 quest charms.

attributions.name: Parchment UI Backing & Reimagined Emblem Logo
attributions.usage_in_project: Aged parchment background texture (assets/ui/background.webp) and defringed medieval illuminated logo (assets/ui/knight_lore_reimagined_logo.png).

attributions.name: Python Ecosystem Libraries
attributions.usage_in_project: Offline asset conditioning, Blender mesh analysis, MIDI orchestration, DSP sound synthesis, and schema validation (tools/pyproject.toml).
